csv_project_name: Developer For Moraga Canyon Specific Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Piedmont is seeking qualifications from a Developer or Developer Team to finance and build housing on City-owned land located in the Moraga Canyon Specific Plan (MCSP) area. Development of the MCSP area must include 132 housing units (with a minimum of 40 percent, but no less than 60 affordable units) as well as various public amenities and supporting infrastructure.
